## [1.1.0](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/compare/code-review-cost-monitor-action@v1.0.0...code-review-cost-monitor-action@v1.1.0) (2026-08-22)

## Release Notes

The cost monitor's companion review action now assembles all PR context in a single, upfront step before the review session begins, replacing the scattered discovery work that previously happened during each run.

## ✨ What's New

### Deterministic Startup Context Bundle

PR context — diff, metadata, related discussions — is now gathered once in a dedicated builder step that runs before the review session starts, rather than being discovered on-demand across multiple points during the run. This makes startup behaviour predictable and repeatable: the same PR produces the same context payload every time, with no variance from timing or ordering effects.

The review run-summary footer (the data source the cost monitor reads from every PR) now includes six new fields from the builder: duration, request count, payload size, whether truncation occurred, follow-up count, and fallback status. This richer telemetry means the cost monitor has more signal to work with when evaluating a run — particularly for diagnosing why a high-cost run breached a threshold, which is exactly the kind of analysis the optional attribution step was designed to surface.

From a deployment standpoint, no new configuration is required. The bundle step is built into the review action and runs automatically. Cost reports and baseline windows continue to work as before; the additional footer fields appear in new runs going forward.
